dana_pm: Quick alignment: finalizing v1 private deploy launch criteria. must-haves: static egress option, airgap installer tarball, and an explicit rollback playbook.

kai_eng: noted. i'll prototype an `egress.lbAddress` flag and a minimal offline bundle (images + manifests + checksums).

mira_field: Field asks: clear installer error messages and a visible upgrade banner. also customers want opt-in auto-upgrade only.

sam_sre: Rollback must snapshot KV and provide a <30m fast revert. add network regression tests (egress persistence + peering smoke).

dana_pm: Owners: kai = proto + preflight checks, sam = rollback runbook + tests, mira = beta customers and banner copy. timeline: prototypes next Tue; canary onboarding in 3 weeks.

deploy-bot: CREATED TICKET RW-PRIV-964: "v1 private packaging: static-egress + airgap + rollback"

mira_field: I'll confirm two betas and maintenance windows.

dana_pm: Great. i'll update the roadmap doc with these gates and mark field-prereqs high.
